title: An ability named by a companion
retelling: Jambavan addresses the quiet Hanuman and names his strength, judgement and understanding. He connects those abilities with Rama’s task. Hearing him, Hanuman takes on a vast form.
anchor: Someone else may notice an ability we overlook in ourselves.
question: What quality does this moment bring to mind for you?
citation: Ramcharitmanas, Kishkindha Kanda; after doha 29 and before 30(a), chaupai units 2–3 in the cited online presentation.
